tasks.cmd: pixverse create reference --model seedance-2.5 --quality 1080p --duration 8 --aspect-ratio 16:9 --images /Users/jeff/Documents/Claude/TItoAi/w44-friday-motion-sample/public/chibi-wave.png --prompt 'Image 1 is the exact Tito AI chibi character identity, outfit, tablet and wristwatch. A new 8-second vertical character-animation shot on a clean warm-cream background with navy and gold accents. 0–2s: the character takes two visible steps toward camera, natural leg and torso movement, face turns toward viewer. 2–5s: he lifts his free hand and waves twice with a clear elbow and wrist arc while the other hand securely holds the tablet; hair and shirt respond subtly. 5–8s: he shifts weight, turns three-quarters, points at the back of the tablet with a cheerful, helpful expression, then holds the final pose. Animate mouth and eyebrows as if speaking conversationally, but generate no intelligible speech, captions, logos, or music. Keep facial features, clean-shaven face, tablet back, watch placement and proportions consistent with Image 1. No extra arms or fingers. Stationary portrait camera; the body movement is the focus.'
